citing_body_lines: L437: In order to achieve high throughput retrieval without incurring cloud latency, the algorithm makes use of a strictly local processing paradigm. After being loaded into memory, video frames are immediately processed and discarded. By executing the computation on the local device, no data needs to be transmitted during retrieval. The embeddings are furthermore stored encrypted at rest; the privacy preserving mechanisms are further discussed in related work \cite{p3}. Finally, by only allowing processing of single video frames at a time, the algorithm is physically limited to a retrieval window of one frame.

citing_body_lines: L49: To resolve this challenge, this paper establishes the theoretical foundations, algorithmic design, and empirical validation of an \textit{Adaptive Risk-Driven Cascade Architecture} for edge computing. By consuming the Layer-1 Perception Risk metric $R_p \in [0, 1]$ established in \cite{kumar2026scholar22}—which unifies Dirichlet evidential uncertainty, multi-branch cross-agreement discrepancy, optical blur bounds, and landmark dispersion—the edge runtime dynamically dispatches frames along an optimal accuracy-latency Pareto frontier. Clear, unambiguous frames execute swiftly through an ultra-fast primary model ($1.264\text{ ms}$), while corrupted or ambiguous scenes trigger selective heavy verification ($14.501\text{ ms}$) or fail-closed privacy degradation.

L85: Model cascades date back to the classic Viola-Jones boosted cascade for real-time face detection \cite{viola2001rapid}. Modern deep learning cascades employ lightweight filter models to classify easy inputs, triggering large networks only when confidence falls below a threshold \cite{bolukbasi2017adaptive, wang2018skipnet}. However, existing deep cascades rely on maximum softmax probability (MSP) or predictive entropy for routing. Because deep neural networks are notoriously uncalibrated and overconfident on out-of-distribution inputs \cite{guo2017calibration}, softmax-gated cascades erroneously route severely corrupted frames through the fast path. ScholarMaster replaces heuristic softmax routing with calibrated Subjective Logic Dirichlet vacuity and physical optical blur bounds \cite{kumar2026scholar22}.

L104: Operationally, $\pi(\mathbf{x}) = \mathbb{P}(r(\mathbf{x}) = 1 \mid R_p(\mathbf{x}))$ denotes the probability of invoking the secondary heavy model given the Layer-1 perception risk $R_p(\mathbf{x}) \in [0, 1]$ computed by the upstream integrity gate \cite{kumar2026scholar22}.

citing_body_lines: L137: Secure provenance schemes \cite{b5} typically employ directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) to capture data derivation and file modification histories in a distributed cloud setting. Our approach also uses DAGs, but aims at the more modest goal of recording linear event logs that can be safely stored on memory-constrained edge nodes \cite{b22}. While general-purpose provenance systems such as the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS) aim to make information publicly accessible by default, CPL makes use of permissioned access to satisfy institutional privacy and access control policies \cite{b7}.

citing_body_lines: L39: Modern autonomous cyber-physical edge computing systems---such as automated transit hubs, smart educational campuses, automated manufacturing facilities, and secure healthcare environments---are fundamentally organized as multi-stage, hierarchical processing pipelines \cite{sculley2015hidden, sambasivan2021everyone, leveson1995safeware}. In these mission-critical deployments, raw continuous sensory observations (such as optical video frames, skeletal keypoints, and acoustic streams) are sequentially ingested, filtered, mapped into high-dimensional latent metric spaces for biometric identity recognition, tracked over time via Bayesian kinematic state estimators, validated against temporal logic schedule compliance rules, and finally committed to immutable audit logs for administrative decision-making \cite{kumar2026scholar22, kumar2026scholar23}.

L51: \item \textbf{Absence of Root-Level Fail-Closed Invariants}: Standard pipelines rely on downstream heuristic exception handling rather than provably containing sensory corruption at Layer 1 prior to vector index submission \cite{kumar2026scholar22, kumar2026scholar24}.

L113: \item \textbf{Layer 1 (Perception Integrity)}: Ingests raw multi-modal sensory observations $\mathbf{x} = \{I, \mathbf{k}, \mathbf{a}\}$, evaluates evidential uncertainty, multi-branch disagreement, Laplacian blur, and temporal consistency, computing the composite risk $R_p(\mathbf{x}) \in [0, 1]$ \cite{kumar2026scholar22}. It emits a validated sensory payload $\mathcal{P}(\mathbf{x})$ if $R_p(\mathbf{x}) \le \tau_{risk} = 0.70$, or triggers immediate fail-closed quarantine ($\bot$) otherwise.
